text: Horror novelist Maddie Young, deaf and mute since a childhood illness, lives alone with her cat in a house in the woods, [far from anyone who could hear her|who_suffers|the lonely and isolated]. One night [a masked man with a crossbow|threat|people who kill] kills her neighbour outside her glass door and, realising Maddie cannot hear, decides she is next. He cuts the power, slashes her tyres and steals her phone, and Maddie, [locked inside with no way out|rules|trapped with no way out], must fight back in silence.
